summary: Nexa Resources S.A. filed a Form 6-K with CEO and CFO certifications for the interim period ended March 31, 2026, as required under Canadian National Instrument 52-109, relying on an exemption from interim MD&A preparation. The filing includes standard certifications regarding the review, fair presentation, and design of disclosure controls and internal control over financial reporting. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is disclosed. The filing is a routine regulatory certification.
